items.title: Apple TV is raising its subscription prices again
items.content: Now, Apple TV subscriptions will cost $14.99 per month, up from its previous price of $12.99 per month.

items.title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap
items.content: Apple says it will no longer ditch using its icloud.com domain for hiding people's email addresses.

items.title: Apple debuts its ‘most powerful chip ever’ in M5 Ultra and M6
items.content: Apple unveils these new processors alongside an updated Mac Mini and Mac Studio.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.content: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.content: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

items.title: Chevron Is in Talks to Expand in Venezuela, a Potential Win for Trump
items.content: President Trump’s administration has been pushing U.S. companies like Chevron to invest more in Venezuela’s oil industry.

items.content: Kevin Warsh reiterated the Federal Reserve’s commitment to tackle rising prices, nudging up investor expectations of a rate increase.
